newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Placer Pac says Placer Dome bid fair.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Placer Pac says Placer Dome bid fair.

text.p: Placer Pacific Ltd said on Tuesday that the bid for the company by its Canadian parent, Placer Dome Inc, was judged to be fair and reasonable by an independent report prepared by merchant bank Grant Samuel and Associates.
Placer Pacific said the report valued the company in a range of between A$1.70 to A$1.94 per share compared a value attributed to Placer Dome's offer of between A$1.80 to A$1.85 per share.

"The independent directors of Placer Pacific intend to recommend to shareholders that they either accept the Placer Dome offer in the absence of any better offer or sell their Placer Pacific shares on-market before the end of the offer period," the company said in a statement.
Placer Dome launched bids for Placer Pacific and another gold miner, Highlands Gold Ltd, in November last year.
Both Placer Pacific and Highlands own 25 percent stakes in the giant Porgera gold mine in Papua New Guinea.
Placer Dome, which held 75 percent of the Australian offshoot prior to launching the mop-up bid, has offered one of its shares for every 15 Placer Pacific shares.
Placer Pacific said its directors were in the process of finalising their recommendations to shareholders and anticipated that their full recommendations would be made by February 14.
Placer Pacific shares closed three cents higher at A$1.76.
